body.statement: Sun, Xie, and Zhang analyze one integrated ATT estimator and one multiplier-bootstrap construction under alternative conditional-parallel-trends and group-level synthetic-control hypotheses. Theorem 2 gives the PT asymptotic law, Theorem 3 gives the SC asymptotic law, the corresponding influence functions and asymptotic variances may differ, and Theorem 4 establishes multiplier-bootstrap consistency under either theorem's assumptions.

source.verbatim_statement: the bootstrap asymptotic distribution converges to the true asymptotic distribution of the estimator, regardless of the identification assumption.

attestation.note: Primary arXiv v2 PDF downloaded from https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.11375v2; Theorem 2 gives the PT asymptotic law with influence function (A.5), Theorem 3 gives the SC law with influence function (A.13), and Theorem 4 proves multiplier-bootstrap consistency under each theorem assumptions.

body.justification: This source node records exactly that one integrated estimator and one multiplier construction are analyzed under alternative PT and SC hypotheses.
body.gap: The source supplies branch-specific laws, not the strict-interior union tangent intersection or its convolution lower bound.
body.consumer: The Alaska application motivates the benchmark; this paper adds no implemented standard-error procedure.
